companion.exactTextOrSilentPurpose: A statement or planned meeting is different from a named policy action.

outcomes.observation: The microphone and loose sheet represent public remarks; the distinct blank formal document identifies the separate category of a formal action without depicting a signed rule.
Detailed deep-ink linework, cyan/coral/yellow/paper palette and halftone texture fit the approved adult editorial pop-art grammar; setting is neutral.
No person, named character, town place, party symbol, flag, company mark or politician appears.
Microphone is mounted to the podium; the papers have coherent planes and the loose sheet is visibly wind-lifted.
No readable generated text, pseudo-text, label, logo or watermark is visible.
Every object supports the remarks-versus-formal-action teaching contrast; no decorative character or unrelated prop appears.

limitations: Producer review only. An independent visual reviewer must inspect the exact pixels and companion before publication.
The blank formal document is an explanatory contrast, not evidence that a rule exists.
